university: All Swedish Public Universities (KTH, Chalmers, Lund, Uppsala, Umeå, Linköping)
title: Swedish Salaried Doctoral Position (Doktorandanställning)
provider: Swedish State University System & Swedish Higher Education Ordinance (Högskoleförordningen)
tuition_coverage: Full 100% free tuition for all doctoral students (tuition fees are legally waived by Swedish law for PhD researchers)
stipend_amount: 31,000 - 35,500 SEK/month gross employment salary (regulated by collective bargaining agreements) + full statutory pension, paid vacation (28 days/yr), healthcare, and parental leave benefits
duration: 4 to 5 years (100% research or 80% research + 20% departmental duties)
associated_lab_or_professor: Faculty research group across Swedish universities
eligibility_notes: PhD researchers in Sweden are legally recognized as university employees with full labor rights, social benefits, and residence permits for doctoral study leading to permanent residence.
